transcript.text: In this video, you’ll animate a title: how it arrives, what it does on screen, and how it leaves.
In Animated, the interface is blue, and the player sits under the stage.
Select a title, and open the Animate tab.
Every title plays in three parts: it animates in, stays on screen, then animates out. Preview plays just this title.
Transition in is how the title arrives. Presets are grouped: cute, cartoony, professional and fun.
Set its duration, the stagger between letters, and whether it moves by letter, word, line, or all at once.
While on screen, a gentle loop keeps the title alive between its entrance and its exit.
Transition out is how it leaves the screen.
The player plays the whole title. Press play, or drag the bar to scrub through it.
Hold sets how long the title stays on screen. Loop repeats it while you work.
Press K to play or pause at any time.
